name: Touya Misaki
source:
She has a bright and not shy personality, is good at getting a sense of distance, and quickly becomes friends with people.

She and Hyouka are twins, but after losing their parents at a young age, they were adopted into different families and lived separately.

Her adoptive parents were very kind to her, but her adoptive father died of illness, and her adoptive mother also fell ill and is now living in an orphanage while undergoing rehabilitation.
As a result, she currently lives alone.

She wants to work in a job that helps people, and is considering going into medicine in the future.

Her birth mother is a flute player, and she started playing the flute because of her influence. She is mostly self-taught, but has acquired the skill to perform in front of people.
